scientific_integrity: The proof uses a closed Gaussian identity, globally exhaustive sign cases, and analytic differentiation for the area invariant. Numerical tests are independently reproduced but do not certify all-parameter claims. Earlier qualitative discussion of vanishing unequal-amplitude cat blind spots is not silently equated with the present global statement.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for two real unchirped equal-width Gaussians of strictly positive separation, width and amplitude ratio; cycles-frequency units. All-plane zeros need not be experimentally observable at tiny amplitudes. An equivalent older optics derivation is not excluded, nor has an independent audit been performed.
title: One-area Fourier-ambiguity ovals and their collapse under Gaussian amplitude imbalance
